chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Marid, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah عليه السلام saying:
There is no believer who has a milking goat in his house except that the people of that house are sanctified and blessed. If there are two, they are sanctified twice each day.
Then a man from our companions said: How are they sanctified? He said: It is said to them: Blessing be upon you, and may you be wholesome, and may your condiment be wholesome.
He said: I said: Then what is the meaning of "you are sanctified"? He said: "You are purified."

key_terms.أَهْلُ ذَلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ: the people of that house; the household members
key_terms.إِدَامُكُمْ: your relish or accompaniment to food; here meaning the household’s food provision
key_terms.بُورِكَ: was blessed; divine blessing was bestowed
key_terms.طُهِّرْتُمْ: you were purified; the explanation of sanctification in this report
key_terms.عَنْزٌ حَلُوبٌ: a milking goat that provides milk for the household
key_terms.قُدِّسَ: was sanctified; here meaning purified and blessed
key_terms.مُؤْمِنٍ: a believer; the person described as receiving this blessing

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about keeping a milking goat in the home?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the presence of a milking goat in a believer’s home brings blessing and purification to the household. It portrays simple lawful provision as a source of barakah and explains that being sanctified here means being purified.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4226 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Marid, who said:
"I heard Abu Abdullah (as), say: 'There is no believer who has a milking goat in his house except that the people of that house are sanctified and blessed.

If there are two goats, they are sanctified twice each day.'
A man from our companions then asked: 'How are they sanctified?'
Imam (as) replied: 'It is said to them: Blessed are you, and may your food be pure and wholesome.'
I said: 'What is the meaning of being sanctified?'
Imam (as) said: 'It means you are purified.'"
